messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: In the Mounjaro prescribing information, SURPASS-1 (NCT03954834) was a 40-week trial.
The trial was in adults with type 2 diabetes.
The adults had blood sugar that was not adequately controlled with diet and exercise alone.
Patients received once-weekly Mounjaro 5 mg, 10 mg, or 15 mg, or placebo.
After 40 weeks, 78% to 85% of adults taking Mounjaro achieved an HbA1c below 7%.
This is compared with 23% of adults taking a placebo.
The average HbA1c change was -1.8% with Mounjaro 5 mg.
The average HbA1c change was -1.7% with Mounjaro 10 mg.
The average HbA1c change was -1.7% with Mounjaro 15 mg.
The average HbA1c change was -0.1% with placebo.
Triplet: ["Mounjaro 15 mg", "average hba1c change", "-1.7%"]

The relation 'average hba1c change' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject treatment or drug resulted in the specified average change in HbA1c levels.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has treatment for hypoglycemia': The subject drug is associated with the treatment or intervention specified by the object entity for managing hypoglycemia.
B. 'has dose increment': The subject drug's dose is increased by the specified amount at regular intervals.
C. 'has dose adjustment instruction': The subject drug may require changes in dosage based on the condition or factor specified in the object entity.
D. 'increases level of': The subject drug increases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
E. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
